attBesluta.text: This has done great for 3 months now! I have no complaints! I love the squeegee that came with it too

We've been using this tub for a year now and while it is very decent to use there was an issue with one of the bends of the metal on the end pieces. The metal broke at the bend Point leaving a very razor sharp edge for about 6 in. Vevor could not get me that piece to be replaced so they did send me a partial refund. Overall this tub is a good investment but just be aware of the upper panels durability.
